answer.rationale: Memory_73 directly supports targeted promotional pricing for price-sensitive SMB segments, matching today's situation (competitor price cut, doubled SMB churn conversations). However, unlike exp_44 and exp_31, memory_73 was not part of this cycle's freshly re-verified archive pulls, and our verification budget is exhausted, so we cannot confirm it still holds or check for retention/margin erosion risk. Given the objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, a broad rollout on unverified-this-cycle pricing memory risks margin compression and price-war dynamics that promotional pricing memories don't address (they show acquisition/revenue lift but say less about long-term unit economics under competitive spiral). A small guarded test lets us respond to urgent leadership pressure and churn signal while limiting downside exposure until next week's verification budget resets. Other candidates (onboarding, referral, activation, enterprise-assist) are supported by memories addressing different problems (activation, retention pipeline, enterprise conversion) and don't target the acute SMB price-sensitivity signal seen today.
